原: How did it go? / at The bank this morning.

原: …any business loan I’m given, well, that doesn’t sound fair.

原: …led by international corporations, while farming is often difficult…

原: Sometimes the old stuff. / Just works better, or more efficiently.

原: Passage two: Eat Grub is Britain’s first new food company…
